'''Aaron McCormack''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[June 2000 Phoenix tournament (25 June)]] on 25 June 2000 with [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|Ralltiir Operations]], according to Brian Garrison's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d945">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-26-it-has-a-cute-buttd945/ it-has-a-cute-butt], DeckTech (Brian "bgkenobi" Garrison, 26 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-26-it-has-a-cute-buttd945/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
